propositions: The review-code gate must activate the LLM step-failure sink in its run scope and drain the tally to coverage.llm_step_failures on the verdict, absent only when empty.

The verify-completion gate must activate the LLM step-failure sink in its run scope and drain the tally to coverage.llm_step_failures on the verdict, with the entire coverage object created only when non-empty to preserve byte-identity of clean signed verdicts.
Both code_review_verdict.schema.json and completion_verdict.schema.json must declare coverage.llm_step_failures with required [total, by_step] and minimum 1 per field.

The completion verdict placement decision chooses coverage.llm_step_failures (mirroring review-plan and review-code) over a bespoke top-level key to maintain one consistent JSON path across all three gates and preserve attestation safety via byte-identity on clean runs.
